description: Inserts a missing be verb only for pronoun-subject location predicates with whitelisted location phrases.
fp_risk_note: High risk. Be-insertion rules can misfire on questions, fragments, noun-postmodifier surfaces, and sentences with existing finite verbs. V1 only handles pronoun subject plus whitelisted location phrase with no finite verb, blocks questions, and defers name/noun subjects.

positive.notes: First-person pronoun plus whitelisted country location takes am.
Third-person singular pronoun plus whitelisted school location takes is.
Plural pronoun plus whitelisted room location takes are.

negative.notes: Existing finite verb means this is not be-drop.
Existing adjective be-drop rule handles adjective predicates; location be-drop must not fire.
Name subjects and non-place accounting are deferred.

negative.input: The class on Monday is hard.
negative.expectedCorrection: The class on Monday is hard.
negative.notes: Noun-postmodifier surface with existing finite verb must not be rewritten.
